subject: planner: refactor exhaustPhysicalPlans (#63508)
summary: Reviewed this commit relative to its first parent, scoped to planner changes. The change is a refactor that centralizes physical-plan enumeration in a new dispatcher (`pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go:54`) and moves several operator-specific exhaust routines (CTE/Limit/Selection/Projection/Aggregation/UnionScan) into `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/*`, while introducing `base.GetGEAndLogical` and `Get*StatsAndSchema` helpers to support both volcano and cascades memo (`pkg/planner/cascades/memo/group_expr.go`). Spot-checked moved logic against the pre-refactor implementations (index-join prop admission, projection/selection pushdown, agg plan enumeration) and did not find any remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantic issues. Checked later history on `upstream/master` for follow-ups in the touched files; nothing indicates an unfixed Blocker/High remaining in current upstream.
